title: POTS findings v1.2, package 1 of 5: POTS and dysautonomia core literature (36,067 findings, 3,129 papers)
description:
Package 1 of 5. 36,067 structured findings extracted from 3,129 papers (2019–2026) covering dysautonomia, POTS, dysautonomia subtypes, hyperadrenergic POTS.

One block of a five-way partition of an 11,519-paper, 148,186-finding corpus of the POTS, dysautonomia and comorbid-condition literature. The five packages share zero papers; per-package counts sum exactly to the corpus totals.

Self-contained. Includes the findings table (parquet and CSV), a data dictionary with fill rates measured on this slice, the QA evidence behind every stated number, the pinned extraction and validation code, and code/verify_package.py, which re-derives every headline number from the shipped data and exits non-zero on disagreement.

Ontology identifiers (v1.2): every identifier the extraction model emitted was checked by id at its authority (HGNC, ChEBI, MeSH). Of 4,373 rows with an id, 2,385 were confirmed, 1,161 were replaced by the id the entity name resolves to, and 827 were withheld. Join only on rows where ontology_id_verification is authority_verified or authority_verified_retrospective. See LIMITATIONS.md.

Quote verifiability: 18.12% of rows have a provenance quote whose own source text is still available and re-checkable.

Scientific fidelity is unmeasured. All QA verifies well-formedness, not whether a finding correctly interprets its source. Treat every row as a pointer to a paper to read.

Paper flags: includes annotations/paper_flags.csv, which marks 1 retracted paper, 2 correction notices extracted as papers, 49 papers with a published correction and 10 duplicate records (preprint and published versions, co-publications). Exclude or count them as the file recommends; no row was removed. Checked against PubMed and Crossref on 2026-10-26.

Not medical advice.
notes: The provenance_quote column contains short verbatim excerpts from the source publications and is NOT covered by CC BY 4.0, that text remains the copyright of the respective publishers and authors. See LICENSE for the excerpt policy and takedown commitment.
